title: [performance][observability] report to live: a landing on a source no deploy ships is live when it lands (a measurement fix: it corrects the figure, not the work), and the Core lines card says each mission's report to live beside the fleet's
prompt:
Spawn, objective 159 [performance][observability]: a landing on a source no deploy ships is live when it lands, and the Core lines card shows each mission's report to live beside the fleet's. This is a MEASUREMENT FIX. It corrects the north star's figure, not the work: nothing gets faster, and no gate, integrator or deploy step reads the figure (monitoring only). Core line 5, option A of sync/analysis-report-to-live.md, scoped with projects-47 on 2026-11-14.

Where things stand (live main e45ad3c0):
- `performance.report_to_live` (the Scorecard's `report_to_live`, objective 081; crates/spawn-cli/src/scorecard/history.rs `live()`) runs from a landing task's last `task.reported` to the first `deploy.finished` ok at or after the landing, for every mission.
- Only one source is ever deployed: deploy/on-landing.sh deploys `$SPAWN_LIVE/missions/spawn.git` (line 100, `missions=$live/missions/spawn.git`) and says "a landing on any other source (Supply PA's) deploys nothing here"; deploy/deploy.sh --main builds the same.
- So a Flake Doctor landing (mission 9, missions/flake-doctor.git), live on its source the moment it lands, is charged until the next unrelated Spawn deploy. Over the live record to 11-14 07:30 (102 landings with a report, read through the API):
  - fleet median 33.2 min (the Scorecard read 33.5, n 103);
  - mission 4 (Spawn): 44.1 min. Report → gate verdict 31.8, of which about 12.3 waiting for the source's gate and 14.2 its own run; landed → deploy 11.8;
  - mission 9: 27.1 min, of which 25.6 is "landed → deploy", a deploy that does not ship it; report → landed is 0.9.
- On live (the lead's timing, 11-14: 0.21–0.45 ms), the missions no deploy ships are [6, 8, 9]:
  - 6, Supply PA, and 8, "Owner work on Supply PA" (owner-reviewed changes, protected files included): both on `missions/supply-pa.git`;
  - 9, Flake Doctor, on `missions/flake-doctor.git`.
  No deploy applies to Supply PA. Its repository holds no deploy script and nothing that writes `deploy.finished`; only deploy/on-landing.sh and deploy/deploy.sh write it, for spawn.git; and it is frozen (owner, 11-10). Its landings are live on its main when they land. The rule: for a product with no deploy, live = on main. sync/features.md (line 9) defines Supply PA's Landed as "on main, controller updated", and that controller update is the gate's, not the product's: it changes what judges the next candidate, not what the product's user runs, so it does not count here. If Supply PA (or any other source) ever gains a deploy, that deploy has to record which source it ships before its landings can wait for it here.
- With the fix, the fleet median would read about 25.2 min. Mission 9 reads about 1 min, and mission 4 is unchanged.
- The fleet figure mixes the two, so the real Spawn wait is hidden behind Flake Doctor's near-zero. The card must show each mission's figure on its own.

Read: crates/spawn-cli/src/scorecard/history.rs (`Facts`, `History`, `Landing`, `live()`), crates/spawn-cli/src/scorecard/measure.rs (`Counts`, `report_to_live`), crates/spawn-cli/src/scorecard.rs (`measure`), crates/spawn-postgres/src/scorecard.rs (`scorecard_facts`), crates/spawn-cli/src/serve/core_lines.rs (`Figure`, `figure_json`), crates/spawn-cli/src/serve/core_lines/performance.rs (`performance`, `performance_line`), web/src/coreLines.ts, web/src/components/home/CoreLines.tsx, deploy/on-landing.sh (its header and `missions=`), docs/design.md (report to live), docs/storage.md (the performance line).

Required behaviour.
- The missions no deploy ships (crates/spawn-postgres/src/scorecard.rs):
  - `PostgresStore::scorecard_undeployed_missions()` gives the ids of every mission, whatever its state, that has at least one source and none whose path ends in `/missions/spawn.git`. That is the one source on-landing.sh deploys.
  - It is a sorted JSON array. A source that only contains the name (`…/spawn.git.bak`, a bare `/spawn.git`) is another source.
  - A mission with no source is not in it: what it ships is not known, so its landings wait for a deploy as before. This keeps the reviewed scenarios' sourceless missions (081, 095, 132) reading as they did.
  - It is one statement over `mission_missions`, read beside the facts and never kept with them. `scorecard_facts` and its answer are unchanged, and so are its tests.
- The Scorecard (spawn-cli `scorecard::measure`) sets `Facts.undeployed_missions` from that read.
  - In `History::live()`, a landing of a mission in the set is live when it lands: its `report_to_live_ms` is its landing minus its report, and it is marked `live_when_landed`.
  - Every other landing waits for the first ok deploy at or after it, as before. One with no deploy since is not live.
  - `undeployed_missions` `None` (facts built without it, as the unit tests' older stories are) keeps the old reading.
- Every scope's `report_to_live` dimension gains `live_at_landing`: how many of its live landings were live when they landed. `value`, `p90`, `n`, `not_live`, `measured_from_ms` and `covered` are as before, now over the corrected waits.
- The Core lines answer: the performance values gain `report_to_live_by_mission`, but only when a mission has a live landing. Each mission scope with `report_to_live.n` above 0 gives `{mission, value, n, live_at_landing}`, by mission; `value` is null below the Scorecard's minimum. The north star (`Figure.by_mission`) says it as `by_mission`. No other figure carries it.
- web/src/coreLines.ts:
  - `CoreFigure.by_mission?: CoreMissionFigure[]`.
  - `missionMark(raw)` gives `{name: "mission <id>", text, tone}`. The text is "<span> (<n> live)", or "<n> live, too few for a median" without a value. When every live landing was live when landed, it adds " · live when landed (no deploy ships it)" with tone "muted"; otherwise the tone is "plain".
  - `coreLinesView(answer).byMission` is the performance line's north star `by_mission` in those words, empty without it.
- CoreLines.tsx lists `byMission` under the performance line, as "Report to live by mission", the way it lists the restore drills and the scratch.
- Docs:
  - docs/design.md, report to live: one sentence on the rule (only `<live>/missions/spawn.git` is deployed; a landing on another source is live at its landing; a mission with no source keeps waiting; `live_at_landing`; "This corrects the figure, not the work").
  - docs/storage.md, the performance line: `by_mission`.
- The trend: the hourly `host.core_lines` samples taken before the landing keep the old values. The 7-day trend of `performance.report_to_live` steps down at the deploy, and that step is the measurement change, not a speed-up. Said here for the lead; nothing rewrites old samples.
- Not changed: every other dimension (lead time, gate time, first pass, cost), every alert rule, deploy/on-landing.sh, the guardrails' ranges. If on-landing ever deploys another source, the path rule in UNDEPLOYED_MISSIONS moves with it (named in its doc).
- Polled read, said for the lead: the Core lines answer (Home polls it, kept 60 s) and /api/scorecard each add one statement over `mission_missions` (a row per mission, 9 rows on live). The SELECT is `UNDEPLOYED_MISSIONS` in crates/spawn-postgres/src/scorecard.rs: rev-f or the lead times it on live before the PASS.

Tests (no test renamed or dropped):
- spawn-cli scorecard/tests.rs `a_landing_no_deploy_ships_is_live_when_it_lands`:
  - mission 9 undeployed and mission 4 not. Mission 9's landings are live at landing (2 and 5 min), with a deploy before and after them changing nothing. Mission 4's wait for their deploys (30 and 50 min); one after the last deploy is not live.
  - The fleet: value 5 min, n 4, not_live 1, live_at_landing 2. Mission 4 n 2, live_at_landing 0; mission 9 n 2, live_at_landing 2.
  - Without `undeployed_missions`, and with none undeployed, the old reading (30 min).
- spawn-cli serve/core_lines/performance.rs `report_to_live_per_mission_is_said_beside_the_fleets`: the per-mission values and the north star's `by_mission` (a mission with n 0 left out), and no key at all when no mission has a live landing.
- spawn-postgres tests/scorecard.rs `the_store_names_the_missions_no_deploy_ships`: none at first. Then missions 4 (spawn.git, active), 7 (two sources, one spawn.git, done), 9 (flake-doctor.git, active), 8 (flake-doctor.git, done), 5 (no source) and 6 (`…/spawn.git.bak` and `/spawn.git`): [6, 8, 9].
- web/test/coreLines.test.ts: a new test (mission 4, 9 and an under-minimum 6; another line's `by_mission` ignored; `missionMark(null)`). The two existing `coreLinesView(null)` / `({})` assertions gain `byMission: []`; that is the only edit to an existing test.
